turns.replyText:
Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular and beginner-friendly choices are the Sansevieria (Snake Plant) and the Peace Lily.
• Sansevieria (Snake Plant): Exceptionally easy and forgiving of neglect. It thrives in low to bright indirect light, requires very infrequent watering, and is a fantastic NASA-listed air purifier.
• Peace Lily (Spathiphyllum): Graceful with dark green foliage and long-lasting white blooms. It prefers moderate, indirect light and likes to stay evenly moist, also serving as a top air-cleansing choice.
If you prefer a low-maintenance plant that thrives even with minimal attention, the Sansevieria is your best choice. If you enjoy flowering plants and don't mind keeping the soil consistently moist, the Peace Lily is a wonderful fit! Is there anything else I can help you with?
